name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
**Decision:** Add a **bold, full-width focus ring** (4px, 2:1 contrast ratio) on all focusable elements in EXCAVA.

This maximizes visibility for keyboard users, especially on low-contrast backgrounds, without relying on color alone. The trade-off is slightly more visual noise, but it’s necessary for users who navigate exclusively by keyboard.

name: Reader
text: **Risk:** A bold, full-width ring creates a "siren effect" for keyboard users—it’s visually overwhelming and breaks the flow of scanning content. **Alternative:** Use a subtle 2px ring with a 3:1 contrast ratio, only on the element’s border (not full-width), paired with a visible focus indicator on hover/focus states. **Settle it:** Test both with 5 keyboard users—if the bold ring causes hesitation or fatigue, switch to the subtle version.

name: Ramp
text:
**Decision:** Use a **2px solid ring with 3:1 contrast**, inset 1px from the element’s edge, appearing instantly on focus.

This balances visibility and subtlety—clear enough for keyboard users to track focus without overwhelming the page. The trade-off is slightly less prominence than a 4px ring, but it avoids the "siren effect" while still meeting WCAG’s minimum contrast for focus indicators.

name: Reader
text: **Risk:** A 2px inset ring risks being missed on high-DPI or low-contrast screens—keyboard users may lose track of focus entirely. **Better alternative:** Use a **3px ring with 4.5:1 contrast**, inset 1px, but add a **subtle 1px outer glow** (2px spread) to ensure visibility without the siren effect. **Settle it:** Test with 3 keyboard users—if any lose focus, default to a **4px ring with reduced opacity (70%)** for balance.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a **3px solid focus ring (4.5:1 contrast)**, inset 1px with a **1px outer glow (2px spread)**, instantly visible on focus for all focusable elements in EXCAVA. Owner: Ramp.
